name: diagram-design
description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A tool that makes an AI assistant draw good-looking diagrams (flowcharts, org charts, timelines) that actually match your brand, instead of generic ugly boxes.
buyer: A startup founder or content writer who needs polished diagrams for blog posts, pitch decks, or documentation but doesn't want to hire a designer or fight with Figma.
business_use_cases: A content marketing agency uses it to produce on-brand explainer diagrams for every client blog post in minutes instead of commissioning a designer.
A solo SaaS founder generates architecture and pricing diagrams for their landing page and investor deck without design skills.
A technical writer at a startup standardizes all documentation diagrams (flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams) on one consistent visual style.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium brand-matched theme packs (beyond the default light/dark/editorial variants) to agencies and design-conscious startups.
Offer a hosted 'diagram-as-a-service' API that agencies can call from their own content pipelines.

steal_this: Build a one-click 'blog post to diagram pack' service: paste a blog draft, get five on-brand diagrams generated with this skill, sell it to content marketers this weekend.
